scientific_integrity: Analytical proof includes exact whole-interval 16-tree comparison and all-exponent critical-point monotonicity. Numerical diagnostics do not establish asymptotic or continuous statements.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical one-parameter two-pair mass orbit has a unique maximizer; the unrestricted p<1 Hilbert-to-free norm is unproved. The spanning-tree norm algorithm is established prior work; bibliographic priority of the symmetry-breaking profile merits independent checking.
title: Symmetry breaking of balanced molecules in four-point Lipschitz-free \(p\)-spaces
